abilities.name: Prepare Spell
abilities.description: Each day you can pick a different magical effect and cast it as a spell. Choose a low-power manifest cypher. After spending ten minutes preparing, you gain that cypher’s effect as a spell (a character special ability). You can cast that spell as an action, costing 2 Intellect. This spell does not count toward your cypher limit. Unlike when using a cypher, you do not lose this spell after casting it.
